chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to us, he said: Abu and Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, they said: Ahmad ibn Hilal narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated to me in the year 204 AH, he said: Sa'id ibn Ghazwan narrated to me, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his fathers (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, Allah chose a thing from every thing; He chose Mecca from the earth, and He chose the Mosque from Mecca, and He chose the place containing the Kaaba from the Mosque. He chose the females from among the cattle, and the ewe from among the sheep. He chose Friday from among the days, and He chose the month of Ramadan from among the months, and from among the nights He chose the Night of Predestination. He chose the Banu Hashim from among the people, and He chose me and Ali from among the Banu Hashim. He chose al-Hasan and al-Husayn from me and from Ali, and He completed them with twelve Imams from the progeny of al-Husayn. The ninth of them is their hidden one, and he is their apparent one, and he is the best of them, and he is their Qa'im (the Rising One).
ai.seo_question: What is the theological significance of divine selection (ikhtiyar) in Shia Islam regarding the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* establishes the theological foundation of *al-Ikhtiyar* (divine selection), tracing a hierarchy of sanctity from the cosmos to the Ahl al-Bayt. It specifically identifies the ninth Imam as the *Qa'im* (the Rising One), whose 'batin' (inner reality) and 'zahir' (outer appearance) are unified, a key concept in Shia eschatology regarding the Mahdi's occultation and eventual reappearance. The text underscores the unique status of the Imams as the culmination of Allah's choice among all creation.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (7) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Abu Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari from Ahmad bin Hilal from Muhammad bin Abu Omayr from Sa’eed bin Ghazwan from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) from his fathers (as) that the Prophet (S) had said:

“Allah the Almighty has chosen a thing from every thing. He has chosen Mecca from the earth, the mosque from Mecca and the place, in which the Kaaba is, from the mosque. He has chosen the females from among the cattle and the ewe from among the sheep. He has chosen Friday from among the days, Ramadan from among the months and the Night of Predestination from among the nights. He has chosen the Hashimites from among the peoples, has chosen me and Ali from among the Hashimites, has chosen al-Hasan and al-Husayn from me and Ali and then He completed the twelve imams from the progeny of al-Husayn. The ninth of them (of al-Husayn’s progeny) is the hidden and the apparent and the best of them. He is the expected imam.” The same was narrated by Muhammad bin Hammam and Muhammad bin al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Jumhoor from al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Jumhoor from Ahmad bin Hilal from Muhammad bin Abu Omayr from Sa’eed bin Ghazwan from Imam Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as).
